import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
# load · cohen_d · ols = 3장·13장·14장에서 만든 도우미

exp = load("exp")                                   # 380 → 366
t, c = exp[exp.cond == 1], exp[exp.cond == 0]
print(len(exp), len(t), len(c))
# 366 183 183

for v in ["age", "mil_t1"]:
    print(v, round(cohen_d(t[v], c[v]), 2))
# age -0.06
# mil_t1 -0.01

chi2, p, df, _ = stats.chi2_contingency(pd.crosstab(exp.cond, exp.gender))
print(df, round(chi2, 2), round(p, 2))
# 2 2.28 0.32

raw = load("exp", clean=False)
out = raw[raw.attn_1 == 0]
print(len(out), int((out.cond == 1).sum()), int((out.cond == 0).sum()))
# 14 7 7

items = [c for c in exp.columns if c.startswith("hjs_")]
print(len(items), round(cronbach(exp[items]), 3))
# 21 0.928

for v in ("mil_t1", "hjs", "mil", "flr"):
    print(v, round(t[v].mean(), 2), round(t[v].std(ddof=1), 2),
          round(c[v].mean(), 2), round(c[v].std(ddof=1), 2),
          round(float(stats.skew(exp[v])), 2))
# mil_t1 4.8 1.21 4.82 1.27 -0.33
# hjs 5.27 0.75 5.06 0.78 -0.07
# mil 5.26 1.18 4.98 1.27 -0.31
# flr 5.53 0.89 5.33 0.95 -0.4

th = stats.ttest_ind(t.hjs, c.hjs)                  # 조작 점검
print(round(t.hjs.mean(), 2), round(c.hjs.mean(), 2),
      round(cohen_d(t.hjs, c.hjs), 2), round(th.statistic, 2), round(th.pvalue, 3))
# 5.27 5.06 0.27 2.58 0.01

obs = t.mil.mean() - c.mil.mean()
print(round(obs, 3))
# 0.283

rng = np.random.default_rng(73)                     # 뒤섞기 (12장)
diffs = []
for _ in range(5000):
    fake = rng.permutation(exp.cond.values)
    diffs.append(exp.mil.values[fake == 1].mean() - exp.mil.values[fake == 0].mean())
diffs = np.array(diffs)
print(round((np.abs(diffs) >= abs(obs)).mean(), 4))
# 0.0302

tt = stats.ttest_ind(t.mil, c.mil)                  # t검정
print(round(tt.statistic, 2), round(tt.pvalue, 3))
# 2.21 0.028

print(round(cohen_d(t.mil, c.mil), 2))                       # 13장
# 0.23

tv, cv = t.mil.values, c.mil.values                          # 부트스트랩 (13장)
rng = np.random.default_rng(73)
bd = np.array([rng.choice(tv, len(tv), replace=True).mean()
               - rng.choice(cv, len(cv), replace=True).mean()
               for _ in range(5000)])
print(np.percentile(bd, [2.5, 97.5]).round(2))
# [0.03 0.54]

b, se, p, _ = ols(exp.mil, [exp.cond, exp.mil_t1])           # 공변인 조정 (15장)
print(round(b[1], 2), round(se[1], 2), round(p[1], 3))
# 0.29 0.11 0.007

k = exp.mil_t1 - exp.mil_t1.mean()                           # 중심화 (16장)
b, _, p, _ = ols(exp.mil, [exp.cond, k, exp.cond * k])
print(round(b[3], 2), round(p[3], 3))
# 0.02 0.797
